title: Complete ancestry, background, and equipment-grant semantics
acceptance_criteria:
- Every ancestry trait with deterministic effect is typed, including its save DC, geometry, recharge, and damage where printed.
- Background equipment is structured with embedded choices and currency, not prose.
- Proficiency grants are typed targets drawn from a catalog (with B3), never free text.
- ancestry:dragonborn Breath Weapon carries its typed success branch (shared membership with A2's half-damage predicate).
